info.title: HSRP Dealer Management System API
info.description: Prototype API. Errors are RFC 7807 problem JSON. Order, payment, fitment and inward calls need an Idempotency-Key header.

post.description: Replays every failed or dead delivery of one subscriber, e.g. all VAHAN posts once VAHAN is back.
Gateway → API server-to-server notification (form or JSON body).
Browser return (success and failure URL). Queues a verify and redirects to the caller's return page.
Multipart: photo files `front` and/or `rear` of the embossed plates; each is read by OCR (D45).

get.description: Rejection approval queue, enriched with the order. Decide through POST /approvals/:approvalId/decision.

post.description:
Multipart: fields of FitmentRequest plus photo files `front`, `rear`, `chassis`. Safe to retry with the same
Idempotency-Key (offline sync).
Closes the current period now for one postpaid OEM ('Run billing now').

get.description: The demo OEM's own credentials (they live on the 'OEM side' of the simulation). Used by demo:e2e.

post.description: Pushes a sample order to our own OEM endpoint exactly as an OEM system would (API key, signature, idempotency key).
New-vehicle demo: fresh vehicles in mock VAHAN plus the sheet of who plays which part.

get.description: The batch's Kranti vehicle data file, for download (or upload by hand on the OEM files page).

post.description: Sends the batch's vehicle data file through the import, exactly as an upload on the OEM files page would.
Dealer app / dealer web / staff web order. Dealers order for themselves; staff name the dealer.
Re-tries the wallet hold for an order waiting for funds (after a top-up).
OEM order push: X-Api-Key, X-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body) and Idempotency-Key.

get.description: OEM vehicle data loaded from the OEMs' vehicle data files (staff only).

OemVehicleRecord.description: One row of an OEM vehicle data file (vehicles built and supplied to a dealer).
